currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful aerial/courtyard tower pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke surveys, LiDAR, printed-plan tracing or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observations: Elevated compound view: cream monastic ranges with terracotta roofs/window rhythm, square clock tower/open round colonnade/copper dome, adjoining library with dark green-gray hipped roof, red basilica roof and open courtyards. Broad stone retaining terrace follows the hill. Modern school/sports buildings and vegetation outside selected core are excluded.

Courtyard tower: ashlar lower shaft, raised dark door and split steps/landing, selected lower round panels, upper paired/triple round belfry openings and clocks, projecting square cornice, round columned gallery, solid upper drum, copper dome and small finial/cross. Exact reliefs,clock numerals and sculpture are not reconstructed.
